title: Summary of ChatGPT-Related Research and Perspective Towards the Future of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Summarizing findings from existing literature (e.g., Ortega-Martn et al.) that evaluated the model's detection of language ambiguity and noted instances where the model prioritized gender bias over grammar rules in non-ambiguous situations.

Reviewing external studies (e.g., Hartmann et al.) that used voting advice applications (Wahl-O-Mat) and nation-state agnostic political compass tests to force the model to agree, disagree, or remain neutral on political statements to measure ideological tendencies.
